title: RL-Guided Quantum-ALNS for Constrained VRP
summary: This study develops a hybrid quantum-classical framework for constrained vehicle routing problems, focusing on the pickup-and-delivery problem with time windows. Instead of casting the full routing problem as a stand-alone quantum optimization task, we embed shallow quantum samplers inside the repair phase of an Adaptive Large Neighbourhood Search (ALNS) heuristic. A Deep Q-Network controller decides whether each reduced repair subproblem should be handled by a classical repair heuristic or by a quantum sampler, using features that describe the local repair structure and predicted hardware…
